description: This file is an HTML source for a web-based database viewer dashboard. It contains the structure, styling, and client-side JavaScript code for browsing available databases, viewing tables, and inspecting data in a tabular format.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list upon clicking the refresh button.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing database entries to show their tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in a table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML table for the data fetched from the server.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Prepares table cell content, handling long strings and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better visibility.
